name: Workflow orchestration · Round 1
domainSummary: A durable coordination capability that sequences dependent work, fans tasks out and back in, persists state transitions, schedules or triggers execution, applies retries and timeouts, routes exceptions, and exposes observable recovery points.
evidenceBoundary: Do not draw flowcharts, arrows, clocks, conductor figures, UI, or task labels. Express coordination through connected radial service bays and interrupted routes.

researchSources.title: Project walkthrough
researchSources.use: Repository-backed queued lifecycle, stages, retries, failure handling, operator recovery, and workflow coordination.

assets.name: Workflow orchestration · Canonical Instrument
assets.controlledVariable: refine the accepted baseline into a precise compact technical instrument building; emphasize ordered dependency sequence
assets.thesis: The accepted skill identity is tested in its clearest production form. This version emphasizes ordered dependency sequence.

assets.name: Workflow orchestration · Core Mechanism

assets.thesis: One unmistakable mechanism carries the identity. This version emphasizes fan-out and fan-in coordination.

assets.name: Workflow orchestration · Flow Spine

assets.thesis: Modularity and composition become the identity. This version emphasizes ordered dependency sequence.

assets.name: Workflow orchestration · Verified Core

assets.name: Workflow orchestration · Scale Engine

assets.thesis: Performance and scale are expressed through structure, not speed lines. This version emphasizes durable state transitions.

assets.thesis: The primitive tests the smallest recognizable expression of the skill. This version emphasizes retry timeout and exception routing.

assets.thesis: The synthesis tests a complete skill identity while remaining subordinate to projects and cities. This version emphasizes observable recovery and resumption.
